runV3.purpose: Harden the Hermes agentic loop before starting another broad patch cycle.
runV3.targetName: Hermes Agentic Run v3 Loop Quality Contract
runV3.objective: Define required quality checks for generated drift, stale timestamp churn, no-op patch claims, and human-boundary preservation before run v3 can propose source changes.

qualityGates.name: Generated Artifact Drift
qualityGates.requirement: Generated reports must not leave unstaged drift after validation unless explicitly committed as a declared output.
qualityGates.failureMode: Running checks rewrites report artifacts and leaves the repo dirty.

qualityGates.name: Stale Timestamp Churn
qualityGates.requirement: Timestamp-only rewrites must be classified separately from semantic changes.
qualityGates.failureMode: Repeated commands create noisy commits that only update generatedAt fields.

qualityGates.name: No-op Patch Claims
qualityGates.requirement: Patch apply reports must distinguish changed=true from applied=true.
qualityGates.failureMode: A patch step claims success even when no meaningful file diff exists.

qualityGates.name: Human Boundary Preservation
qualityGates.requirement: Workflow artifacts may prepare metadata, but branch push, PR creation, and merge remain operator-controlled.
qualityGates.failureMode: The workflow reports or performs GitHub lifecycle actions as if autonomous.

qualityGates.name: Declared Target Only Changes
qualityGates.requirement: Run v3 may only modify files declared in the active contract or approval artifact.
qualityGates.failureMode: Patch logic edits broad source files outside the declared target set.

allowedTargets.reason: Generator for the v8.2 loop quality contract.
